title: Lebanese Spinach Stew
description: Try this authentic Lebanese style Spinach stew made with simple ingredients; it's wholesome, well-balanced and perfect to feed a large family

source.rights: Feel Good Foodie. Functional content plus a link, for internal app testing. Not redistributed.

steps.text: In a heavy bottomed saute pan over medium heat, heat 1 tablespoon olive oil and toast the pine nuts until golden, remove and set aside.

raw.text: In a heavy bottomed saute pan over medium heat, heat 1 tablespoon olive oil and toast the pine nuts until golden, remove and set aside.
raw.name: In a heavy bottomed saute pan over medium heat, heat 1 tablespoon olive oil and toast the pine nuts until golden, remove and set aside.

steps.text: In the same pan over medium high heat, heat the remaining tablespoon of olive oil and add the ground beef, season with 7 Spice, 1 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Cook until the meat is browned, about 5-7 minutes. Remove and set aside, keep any oil and juices in the pan.

steps.text: In the same pan, add the cilantro, garlic and crushed red pepper, cook for about 2-3 minutes until fragrant. Add the frozen spinach, remaining salt and cook with the cilantro mixture until softened, about 5 minutes.

steps.text: Add the chicken broth or water and bring mixture to a boil. Return the cooked ground beef and pine nuts to the pan. Lower heat and simmer for 20 minutes until stew thickens.

review.reviewBody:
From the moment I tried your micro chopped salad on pita I’ve been hooked. But this one I keep coming back to because it’s just so delicious and pretty simple. 
I make it with ground turkey as I cannot eat beef for health reasons. I also like it with black forbidden rice when I have some. This and many of your recipes have helped me on my health journey with chronic diseases. Thank you. “It’s so good”.

Hi Yumna, I am very happy to have found this recipe. I come from a traditional home cooking traditional food, making this recipe tasted just like mom made with the right approach and perfectly spiced.
Amazing recipe and so easy to follow. I use this regularly on rotation. Recently found how to boost it further by adding lentils and mushrooms to the soup, and quinoa to the rice.

I tried this recipe today and it was exceptional! Tastes exactly how my mom makes it. Thank you!!!! Def will be making it again, it was super easy to make. I served it on basmati rice instead as my Lebanese rice skills are questionable still.
This recipe is delicious!  My Mother made a similar dish when I was growing up.  So happy to have a recipe to follow now!  Well done as always Yumna!  😊

Thanks for sharing this recipe. I did it without the onions and with fresh spinach, it was very nice. I would try with frozen spinach next time to make life easier but do you use chopped frozen spinach or whole leaf frozen spinach?
This is my 2nd recipe from your website. It's so yummy! Thanks for sharing, everybody loved it

We love the spices in this dish!  It's now on my rotation.  The first time I made it with frozen spinach but the second time I subbed fresh spinach using the measurements given and we liked the dish even better.  The frozen spinach has a bit of a weird taste.  Also, this recipe came up as a vegetarian selection but the ingredients included beef, with a note that garbanzos could be substitued.  I subbed a drained 15 oz can of garbanzos and it was fine.  But it feels like there could be a better conversion to vegetarian.
